name: Mackle Story
storyline:
The Demon Lord, who had been suffering repeated defeats in the war against humans, began a large-scale conscription. The first targets were the Mackle tribe, the smallest and weakest of all monsters.

Though the Mackles resisted desperately, the power of the Demon Lord was overwhelming. One by one, they were captured and forced into the battle against humans. However, the Mackles did not give up. In a small, remote kingdom, one tiny Mackle stood up…

You will take on the role of this small Mackle. Together with your companions, you must train yourself, solve numerous difficult puzzles, and make your way through grueling dungeons. What will become of this little Mackle’s adventure…?
summary:
This game is an Android remake of the nostalgic, classic, and full-scale RPG "Mackle Story," originally released for PC and a huge hit in Japan.

Keeping the fun of the original intact, it features a UI optimized for smartphones, allowing smooth and comfortable gameplay. Additionally, it includes features unique to the mobile version, such as a ranking system. Whether you played the original or not, it's a game everyone can enjoy, so be sure to give it a try.
